name: Rizuhble's Bouncy Castle Viscous
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-6,400 (levels 1-12). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Goo Ball unlocked. Ultimate (Goo Ball) is available from Healing Booster.

items.name: Healing Rite
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Rescue Beam, 8800 souls (~8.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on The Cube: takes 18% off its 42s base cooldown.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Puddle Punch (1 to 2).

items.name: Healing Booster
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Rescue Beam, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 18 to Goo Ball's damage (1.00x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 6,400-16,000 (levels 12-22). Abilities gained (both point models agree): The Cube T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Splatter, damage) grows from 127 to 159. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Mystic Burst, vitality 4.8k at Rescue Beam.

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Splatter (141) clears its 80-damage trigger; Puddle Punch stays under it.

items.name: Rescue Beam
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Healing Rite (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k vitality tier, which Trophy Collector completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Trophy Collector completes 6.4k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 5,600 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.why: spirit investment only; its 6.4k tier completes at Rapid Recharge, 4000 souls (~4.0 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Grit
items.caption: Builds toward the 8k vitality tier, which Guardian Ward completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Guardian Ward completes 8k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Guardian Ward
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 7,200 to 8,000 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Puddle Punch (3 to 4). Takes spirit from 5,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 17,600-41,600 (levels 24-34). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Splatter T3, Puddle Punch T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Splatter, damage) grows from 161 to 331.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 183s; 20% off is 36.6s per full rotation.

items.name: Magic Carpet
items.caption: +14 spirit adds about 22.4 to Splatter's damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 9,600 to 16,000 invested, crossing the 11.2k, 16k tiers: bonus 52 to 66 spirit power.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Splatter (306) clears its 165-damage trigger; Puddle Punch stays under it. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Goo Ball ball hit radius (1.8m), Goo Ball ball radius (1.4m), Splatter radius (6.5m). Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on The Cube: resets its 22s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Takes spirit from 20,800 to 27,200 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Takes vitality from 9,600 to 14,400 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Grit? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Enchanter's Emblem.
sections.desc: Dying after Grit? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Enchanter's Emblem.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry is melting you.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult you can see coming, like Lash's or Infernus's.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep you from punching or cubing in fights.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 48 to Splatter's damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Same-slot upgrade of Improved Spirit for 4,800 more souls: tech power 18 to 30..

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 27,200 to 33,600 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 14,400 to 20,800 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Healing Booster for 4,800 more souls: bonus fire rate 0 to 35; tech resist 0 to 10..
items.legacy_note: Cubing or healing a teammate gives them its fire rate too. Upgrade of Healing Booster.
